description: Implementation of QpackBlockingManager class managing header block dependencies and stream blocking logic in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QpackBlockingManager
classes.description: Manages header block dependencies, reference counts, and stream blocking policies for QPACK in QUIC.

methods.name: OnHeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of header blocks for a stream, updates received count, and manages reference counts.

methods.name: OnStreamCancellation
methods.description: Handles stream cancellation, decreases reference counts, and removes header blocks.

methods.name: OnInsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Increments the known received count by a specified amount, ensuring no overflow.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockSent
methods.description: Records a sent header block and increases reference counts.

methods.name: blocking_allowed_on_stream
methods.description: Determines if blocking is allowed on a given stream based on current header blocks and maximum allowed blocked streams.

methods.name: smallest_blocking_index
methods.description: Returns the smallest index currently blocking streams, or max uint64 if none.

methods.name: RequiredInsertCount
methods.description: Calculates the required insert count for a set of indices.

methods.name: IncreaseReferenceCounts
methods.description: Increases reference counts for a set of indices.

methods.name: DecreaseReferenceCounts
methods.description: Decreases reference counts for a set of indices, removing entries if count reaches zero.
